sections.preamble: You answer questions about a single medical image. Follow the answer format requested in the user message exactly.

content.text:
This is one axial slice of a T2-weighted fat-suppressed MRI (radiological convention: patient right on image left, anterior at top). It contains a fibrous soft-tissue tumor.

The image has pixel rulers along its top and left edges (x increases to the right, y increases downward, 0 at the image's top-left corner). Using the ruler scale, give the position of a point inside the tumor, as close to its centre as possible. End your reply with a final line exactly: ANSWER: (x, y)

The tumor is the large heterogeneous hyperintense mass in the posterior compartment of the thigh. It extends from roughly x=245 to 510 and from y=390 to 695. Its centre falls at about x=390, y=565.

ANSWER: (385, 560)
